trap-superlative.evidence: 'This produces the only stable hadronic states, the proton and neutron.' The maximum-strength 'the only' is asserted without qualification and is false as written: the free neutron is not stable, it beta-decays with a mean life of about 880 s. The block contradicts itself three paragraphs later, where the entire E_0 derivation is built on the decay n -> p + e^- + nubar_e. The proton is the only stable hadron; the neutron is stable only when bound.
trap-superlative.notes: flagged, not fixed — correcting it is a physics edit, not a punctuation one. Proposed: 'This produces the only stable hadronic states: the proton, and the neutron when bound.' FIVE FURTHER FINDINGS, none fixed inline. (1) DEAD/DEPRECATED WITNESS CITATIONS: of the three witnesses the block cites, meson-nucleon-nf.witness.json and beta-decay-energy-scale.witness.json exist ONLY under computations/_deprecated/; only confinement-operator-selection.witness.json is live. (2) That live witness carries z = 0.4993203340335982, which is exactly z_C = sqrt(q)/(q+1) = 0.499320334034, not z_D = q^3/(q^2+1) = 0.612688050546 — and it is used as the Markov parameter building the 6x6 Gram (G_{01} = 0.49932...), so this is a genuine convention-C dependence, not the harmless positivity-inequality use. Convention D was made canonical and C excised by the 2026-08-15 owner ruling. (3) The same witness has y0_star, y_star, dual_obj, duality_gap all null with the status string 'STUB — re-run script through lp_dual_solver.py to populate', so it does not satisfy the AGENTS.md LP/SDP first-class-dual requirement it is subject to. It also records gram_det = -0.1892052530713217, i.e. NONZERO, while its sibling block prf:knot-operator-selection asserts 'on H_n itself det G = 0 exactly'. Those two statements are consistent only if one is convention-C and the other convention-D — which is exactly the split I measure — so the chapter is carrying both conventions at once. (4) DISPLAYED ARITHMETIC DOES NOT REPRODUCE: 'E_0 = 0.782/0.1883 approx 4.155 MeV' — the printed division gives 4.1529, not 4.155. The RESULT is right (the witness has E0_MeV = 4.154925) because it was computed from Q = 0.7823334 and |Delta net| = 0.18829062; it is the rounded display that fails to reproduce it. Proposed: quote 0.78233/0.18829. (5) CIRCULARITY, stated as a verification: 'The six terms sum exactly to Q_beta.' E_0 is DEFINED as Q_beta/|Delta net| and Delta net is by the block's own linearity clause the sum of the six coefficient differences, so sum_i Delta_i E_0 = Q_beta identically. That is the definition unfolded, not a check, and it should not be presented as one. Related: 'Untyped composition yields net approx 1.506. The CODATA proton net is approx 0.999. Typed crossings close this gap.' — CODATA measures masses, not 'nets'; 0.999 is a target, and the typed-crossing shift h_A is introduced to reach it, landing on 0.9991. That is the shape of a fit and should be labelled per the production-vs-exploratory discipline. Two lesser notes: the bold banner '**Full derivation.**' is followed by three summary sentences that derive nothing (the dangling-banner pattern); and the block says 'CODATA 2022' while its witness carries CODATA-2018 masses (m_p = 938.27208816 against the 2022 value 938.27208943). The witness's own auditOnly pointer, docs/audits/categorical-vs-fitted-q-decay-ba.md, does not exist.
